notes.title: DIRT 5 Halloween Content Launches October 1! Free Performance Patch Out Now
notes.content:
That’s right – we’ve gone early! It’s Halloween season in the world of DIRT 5 already, as the FREE* 'Tricks N Treats' Playgrounds update goes live tomorrow (October 1st, 2021), adding a ghoulish set of items to design your darkest racing arenas with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/294076750533eb7dc65675571dc15d60f1409ccc.jpg[/img]

The 'Tricks N Treats' Playgrounds update is a FREE Halloween-themed set of items, available for all players on Steam. Also, rolling out today is our latest patch with more optimisations and improvements, including a major environment lighting update. The Playgrounds content and new patch will also come to Google Stadia at a later date.


[h2]Tricks N Treats: New DIRT 5 Halloween Content[/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/8a10108e74a1ccd87ced45fe0882cf9a08f7331c.jpg[/img]

We couldn’t wait to get into the Halloween spirit this year! Taking inspiration from all your favourite spooky scenes, classic horror setups, and gothic Victorian architecture, the Tricks N Treats pack is a bonus drop of free items for all Playgrounds users to design some truly devilish arenas.

Make use of new start gates, finish gates, and checkpoints with flickering flames and sinister signage. Steer clear of the ominous haunted house, mysteriously glowing in green whenever night falls. Face your fears and speed through the wicker sculpture. Add more spooky stylings to your Playground with decorative delights like bell towers, pumpkins, wells, gargoyles, and more.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/eb7594c14a04c7cc0f94856433067afac99aa19e.jpg[/img]

Make sure to use our recently-added weather options for Playgrounds, like fog and rain, to make your arenas even more atmospheric. Don’t forget: Even if you’re not into creating Playgrounds, head to Discover to race on player-made maps using the new items… if you dare!

This new content will automatically be added to DIRT 5 on October 1. No additional purchase or download is required.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/ad056eb78822e6b55fa6602e7cb351ad7a5cdbf1.jpg[/img] 


[h2]DIRT 5 Update: Lighting Improvements & More Added[/h2]

Update 6.01 also goes live today on Xbox, PlayStation, and PC, with the headline change focusing on lighting improvements to make DIRT 5 even more of a visual delight. New tweaks to the game’s general light, shade, and reflections will be noticeable across every location and scenario, particularly in night-time events, leading to more realistic and natural lighting. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/eeb1851dbeb8df57123a37410df8f842e8e37597.jpg[/img]

Today’s patch addresses other technical matters, including audio fixes, wheel support, Career objectives, crashes, and more. Full details are available on our website. Follow @dirtgame on Twitter and Instagram for more details on today’s update, and show us your creations and racing antics with the Tricks N Treats content by using the hashtag #DIRT5. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/af293236b6f70ddbc4343a3b9e3b2428c95d3e39.jpg[/img]

*Internet connection required

notes.title: More New DIRT 5 Content Now Live: 2021 Ford Bronco, New Tracks & More!
notes.content:
DIRT 5’s summer of thrills shifts up another gear with the Wild Spirits Content Pack and FREE Update 6.00, available right now!

Launching today on Steam, our latest content drop further expands DIRT 5’s car roster, Career experience, and adds another two tracks to conquer. The Wild Spirits Content Pack is included in DIRT 5 Amplified/Year One Edition, or purchasable separately from Steam. Update 6.00, meanwhile, is a free content update for all players, featuring the new tracks, five iconic liveries, and more.

Let’s take a closer look at everything coming your way today…


[h2]DIRT 5 Wild Spirits Content Pack – Two New Cars[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/e6660c5c636f31240c8c508cda6d21839750d54c.jpg[/img]

A pair of eye-catching off-road machines, purpose-built to overcome any terrain, are added to DIRT 5 in the Wild Spirits Content Pack. First up: the hotly-anticipated Ford Bronco Wildtrak 2021. 310bhp and 400 lb.-ft of torque, as well as innovative 4x4 and differential systems, make the new Bronco a perfect addition to take on DIRT 5’s extreme events. Its boxy chassis and huge tyres create an unforgettable look – and that’s before you customise it with liveries and patterns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/73af2b941c38bc7d036ed57d6d89f42a55978d59.jpg[/img]

Alongside the Bronco is the Prodrive Hunter. Billed as a ‘Desert Hypercar’, the Hunter is a production version of the incredible Prodrive BRX, which has competed across Dakar and other events in 2021, with drivers including Sebastian Loeb. Powered by Ford’s 3.5-litre twin turbo V6 engine, producing around 500bhp, the Hunter has all the power you need to dominate DIRT 5’s global off-road events.


[h2]Career Expansion – New Events, Sponsors, Rewards[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/15cc0e868bf2e2688a6311ac8d5e68ad527ab512.jpg[/img]

The Wild Spirits Content Pack for DIRT 5 also further expands our Career mode with another 25 bespoke events, in the ‘Wild Spirits’ bonus chapter. The new events will include chances to race our two new cars, multi-class races, dynamic weather events, and more unique experiences.

Two additional Career Sponsors are also added: Alpinestars and VP Racing Fuels. Head to the Sponsors tab in Career to select either of these sponsors and start to unlock new rewards and content, including fresh liveries and customisation items. Finally, look out for five additional Trophies/Achievements, each connected to your progression in the new Career chapter.

Amplified Edition or Year One Edition owners of DIRT 5 will automatically receive the Wild Spirits Content Pack today, once the new update is downloaded. For Standard Edition players, the pack can be purchased on DIRT 5’s online store page on Xbox, PlayStation, and Steam.


[h2]New DIRT 5 Update – Two Extra Tracks, More Liveries[/h2]

Following the addition of two Brazil Land Rush circuits in July, DIRT 5’s selection of tracks is expanded once again, with a pair or brand new Stampede events in Morocco!

Ait Ojana and Tinghir are the two new routes available to all players from today. These two events are both Stampedes, meaning you should be ready for some big jumps and tough terrain. Overcome the surface, the inclement weather (including sandstorms!) and your opponents to dominate these desert-based tracks in Morocco.

DIRT 5’s free update today will also include five more real-world liveries, added to a quintet of cars. Available to everyone, look out for new designs for the MINI Cooper SX1, Armada Engineering Unlimited Truck, Volkswagen Beetle Rallycross, Porsche Macan T1 Rally Raid, and Renault Megane R.S RX. The new livery for the MINI is the Xite Energy livery, driven by Oliver Bennett in the recent FIA World RX Championship! 

For Playgrounds, we're adding two more weather conditions to help transform your custom racing arenas: fog and sandstorm! Also, this update features a number of gameplay and difficulty tweaks, designed to make DIRT 5’s on-track action even more competitive and action-packed.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/1352a865c7f989c81b1acc9c2851b3ae462f43da.jpg[/img]

Both the Wild Spirits Content Pack and Update 6.00 launch simultaneously on Xbox, PlayStation, and PC, followed by Google Stadia at a later date. Full patch notes for this update are available on our patch notes hub. Follow the official DIRT channels on Twitter and Instagram for gameplay of the new content and more.

[i]This announcement may change as we listen to community feedback and continue developing and evolving our Live Service & Content.  We will always strive to keep our community as informed as possible.
[/i]

notes.title: New DIRT 5 Content OUT NOW: New Tracks, Cars, Playgrounds Challenges & More!
notes.content:
More cars, new tracks, more events, more Playgrounds options – and that’s just the start. DIRT 5’s post-launch expansions continue with the Super Size Content Pack, Update 5.00, and the Parts Unknown Playgrounds Update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/58e5cd2ad1cbfcddf5dce9f14acf4baf45f450c1.png[/img]

A host of new items, achievements, and ways to play are added to the game in this huge update, with a combination of additions for Amplified/Year One Edition players, and free content for all players. All new additions come to Xbox, PlayStation and PC on July 20, followed by Google Stadia at a later date. Let’s take a closer look…

[h2]New Free Circuits – São Conrado and Rio Seafront, Brazil[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/01d39c3005782700da6fb87b3776784988224c5d.jpg[/img]

The first new circuits added to DIRT 5 since launch takes us to the beaches on the outskirts of Rio de Janeiro, for some thrilling circuit-based racing through mud and sand!

São Conrado and Rio Seafront are brand-new additions to Brazil’s selection of tracks. Set in the shadow of the impressive Pedra da Gavea peak, with the backdrop of lush rainforest on one side and the Atlantic Ocean on the other, are a pair of fast-paced Land Rush tracks that wind through thick muddy sections, before sprawling out onto the white beach. With slightly different layouts, both tracks are perfect for powerful off-road machines, with plenty of chances to overtake and get airborne.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/9668a3c7c884d186e0cdf1130ce0295bbe41a0c3.jpg[/img]

These tracks, and their reverse variants, are available in Arcade mode with all customisable weather conditions. Both are used for multiple events in our new Career chapter and can be selected in Online private lobbies.

 

[h2]Super Size Content Pack – Four New Cars[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/208196c72fe9a59e3aebfa6f67c2b471dbc03afa.jpg[/img]

The Super Size Content Pack certainly lives up to its name, with four huge off-road machines ready to take on all terrain and all challengers. First up, our cover star: the Bentley Continental GT Ice Race Car. Don’t be fooled by the name – whilst this Ice Racer will indeed be right at home on sub-zero surfaces at New York, Norway, and Nepal, this 626bhp monster will tear up all surfaces in DIRT 5 on its 22-inch rims; a perfect blend of class and performance, taken to the extreme.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/de5510b8b012f5eb833142a0dfa73849b7d6e47a.jpg[/img]

Whilst the Bentley joins the Rally GT class, the Armada Rock Racer is our second entry to DIRT 5’s monstrous Rock Bouncer class. This intimidating machine, with huge ridged tyres and minimal chassis, is built to take on our most dangerous terrain in point-to-point Path Finder events. For the Cross Raid class comes the Volkswagen Atlas Cross Sport Baja Concept – The Atlas has the power and endurance to conquer any off-road challenge, being a souped-up race version of the already-mighty crossover VW.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/445166b117b86fc3e9b0c93f0b5bedeaa5075ac1.jpg[/img]

Finally, a truly unique all-terrain option for your DIRT 5 garage: the Rezvani Tank. With its roots beginning with a Jeep Wrangler, the Rezvani takes everything up a notch: Power (500 bhp!), bodywork (bulletproof armour!) and insane ridged tyres. Head to the Pre-Runner class to try and tame the Tank.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/60ebc70c88ad26608dc50436986a5e29183cd477.jpg[/img]



[h2]Career Expansion and New Sponsors[/h2]

The Super Size pack further expands DIRT 5’s Career mode with another 27 bespoke events to take on in a new chapter. Each of the car classes featuring the four new vehicles are featured, as is the new São Conrado circuit, and events using the new Playgrounds items. Also, Time Trial events have been created for the fresh Career chapter. Make sure to use the recently-added ghosts feature to see where you can improve your times!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/8da74d95fe1b69862f84adb12265b096f74426cb.jpg[/img]

Two more sponsors – Toblerone and Power Maxed – are available to sign for and earn exclusive rewards for, including liveries, by completing their objectives. More customisation items also arrive in the Super Size Content Pack, such as stickers, lanyards, and more patterns for custom liveries. The Super Size Content Pack is included in DIRT 5 Amplified Edition or Year One Edition. Owners of the Standard Edition can purchase the pack from digital stores.

 

[h2]Parts Unknown Playgrounds Update[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/ae3a7bb113b07f9d97035b34443fd71d7530d5ba.jpg[/img]

Ever wanted to do donuts around a UFO crash site? Or weave between rocket ships at full throttle? Our latest Playgrounds update takes the action to another planet, with the Parts Unknown Playgrounds Update, free to all players!

Inspired by classic science fiction concepts and art deco, this pack of over 20 new objects can be used in Create mode for all event types (Gate Crasher, Playgrounds, Smash Attack). Look out for new ramps and pieces that encourage wall-riding, as well as props and decorations with a space-age theme. The perfect location for our selection of other-worldly Playgrounds items is also added in this update, free to all players. Check out the ‘Area 51’ location option when designing your custom race arenas, offering a new sci-fi inspired backdrop to whatever you create, with multiple weather conditions and times of day available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/b58afdb5628f629621c2208ba6fcf2e06f127586.jpg[/img]
 

[h2]More Additions and Features[/h2]

By popular demand, Update 5.00 will include more real-world liveries for five cars from DIRT 5’s roster of off-road machines. Iconic designs for the BMW M2 Competition, Citroen C3 R5, Fiat Abarth 124 Rally, Porsche 911 RGT, and Porsche Cayenne Transsyberia have been added, available for free to all players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/d951f4a3cfa523f113098186e58d0326f7dea4cb.jpg[/img]

Over in Playgrounds, we’ve also implemented more ways to compete and earn rewards, based on community feedback and requests. Look out for weekly events in the Featured area of the Discover menu, available for free to all players. Every seven days we’ll be bringing you a brand new challenge to take on against the world, with in-game rewards handed out based on your global leaderboard position at the end of the event. For the prolific Playgrounds creators, we’ll also be handing out more rewards for maps that are played and liked the most by our community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/e2ef4a9a9320829e4102f22a81fd5c7cce64a38e.jpg[/img]

More technical tweaks and improvements have been made across the board in Update 5.00. Five more Achievements will also be added. Full details will be shared on our patch notes hub before the update’s release. Follow the official DIRT channels on Twitter and Instagram for all details as this DIRT 5 expansion rolls out.

notes.title: OUT NOW - DIRT 5 FREE Red Bull Revolution Update - Cross-Platform & More!
notes.content:
Who’s ready for a revolution? We’re excited to reveal the Red Bull Revolution Update for DIRT 5: a FREE update for all players, launching on May 11!

Fresh content and new features are added for everyone in our latest game update, headlined by the introduction of cross-platform matchmaking for online play.

A stunning selection of official Red Bull liveries for multiple cars are on the way, along with the iconic Red Bull arch for use in Playgrounds mode. More weather options for our arena creator mode, ghost lap times, and more are also stuffed into this update! Let’s unpack it all and take a closer look…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/7f317ffbc5edfb101e42fb740b59f41d113fd291.jpg[/img]

[h2]DIRT 5: CROSS-PLATFORM MATCHMAKING ADDED[/h2]

Even more action and fun await in DIRT 5’s online multiplayer modes, with the addition of cross-platform matchmaking compatibility for Xbox, PlayStation, and PC (Windows Store and Steam) players. Another key community request added to the game, this allows all public lobbies to connect players on different platforms together, further boosting online activity whenever you jump in. That means busy lobbies and more excitement in every event – whether that’s our extreme racing, or our innovative party modes.

If you’re matchmaking with a party of players, all party members must have cross-platform matchmaking enabled to ensure they can match with racers on other platforms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/685c50895de01060be02c920c896bfc131ac5f35.jpg[/img]

[h2]NEW RED BULL CONTENT IN DIRT 5[/h2]

We’ve hooked up with Red Bull for this free update to deliver a host of new DIRT 5 content! First up: eight fresh Red Bull liveries to show up and show out in. In the usual livery select screen, find a new design for the Audi S1 EKS RX quattro, MINI John Cooper Work Buggy by X-raid, Peugeot 3008 DKR Maxi, and Volkswagen Race Touareg 3. Meanwhile, check out the Porsche 911 RGT to find the official Red Bull Racing Esports livery, ready for you to use. Finally, the Peugeot 208 WRX comes with THREE new Red Bull liveries, including designs driven by both Timmy and Kevin Hansen in the FIA World Rallycross Championship!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/b9de59e1de96718dd1ed64b8cfd67ca8280d14c0.jpg[/img]

Over in Playgrounds, the new DIRT 5 update will also add the iconic Red Bull arch, used across the globe in official events, for you to get creative with in Playgrounds. Use it to plot a path, drift around, and design your dream racing arena with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/5cd1245bdda17825ae021d5d7b9c6d5de3777836.jpg[/img]

[h2]MORE PLAYGROUNDS CONDITIONS IN DIRT 5[/h2]

Sticking with Playgrounds, we’re adding yet more variety to the mode, with wet and stormy weather conditions for each location! Add some extra challenge to your creations by making surfaces wet and low on grip, and bring some spectacle to your map by choosing stormy conditions, complete with lightning strikes and driving rain.

This option is available for all Playground arenas in Arizona, South Africa, and Italy. Try them for yourself in Create, or head to Discover to play on the best community maps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/819f6d0d9e3479c25a90fc29bdf41b3b22908c00.jpg[/img]

[h2]GHOST LAP TIMES ADDED TO DIRT 5[/h2]

Finally, another community-requested feature, ghost lap times, comes to DIRT 5 in the Red Bull Revolution Update.

In Time Trial and Playgrounds (Gate Crasher), you’ll have the option to display relevant lap times from the global leaderboard, straight onto the track: the global fastest lap, the global closest lap to your time, the closest lap time from your friends, or your own personal best time. See the racing lines, figure out where you can shave off the seconds, and rise up the ranks by defeating the ghosts of real-world players from the same platform.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/74a4cb2706e2812f481062a2dfe0d1c1325eef05.jpg[/img]

The Red Bull Revolution Update is a free game update for all DIRT 5 players, which will be available to download from May 11 Steam. No additional purchase or entitlement is required; an internet connection will be required to download the update.

Alongside these key features and content additions, this update will also include technical tweaks, fixes, and optimisations across the board to further improve your experience. For full details on what’s being added and changed, bookmark the [url=https://dirtgame.com/dirt5/news/dirt-5-patch-notes]DIRT 5 patch notes hub[/url], where we’ll post up the patch notes before the Red Bull Revolution Update’s release.

Today and through this week, look out for more special collaborations and activities on DIRT and Red Bull channels around this free update. Get the scoop on all DIRT 5 news by following us on [url=https://twitter.com/dirtgame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/dirtgame/?hl=en]Instagram[/url], and chat with the team in the official [url=https://discord.gg/BYGnqQB]DIRT 5 Discord server[/url]. More brand new screenshots of the new content in this update are below!

notes.title: OUT NOW - New DIRT 5 Content: Cars, Private Lobbies, Achievements & More!
notes.content:
Prepare to get loud in DIRT 5, with Update 4.00 and the Uproar Content Pack, launching March 30!  

New cars, events, items and more come to the award-winning off-road racer, including a host of free content for all players and further exclusive content for Amplified Edition and Year One Upgrade owners. Let’s get into the details, beginning with four familiar machines making their DIRT 5 debut… 

[h2]Uproar Content Pack [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/035c4f0be269f3fdef90ed47354e07e7fd9e0154.jpg[/img]

The Uproar Content Pack restores four of the most exciting and eye-catching machines from our previous extreme off-road title, DiRT Showdown.

First up, the Duke Coupe (above) from the Rally GT Class – a powerful long wheelbase car with hot rod stylings and huge tyres, ready to conquer DIRT 5’s routes in its own unique style. In the Rally Cross class, the Zenden Cup (below) is a perfect addition, with its compact boxy chassis and aerodynamic flair housing a powerful engine – the ideal mix of speed and handling for our off-road events.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/71a70d5a999bc444b0c924b08b377c79d36d64ea.jpg[/img]

The Jackson Adventurer (below), meanwhile, is a bigger beast for the Unlimited Class that’s low on the unnecessary extras and big on shock absorbers, suspension and speed for those big jumps. Finally, the Jackson Eulogy (second below) – the most unique of our latest cars, with an estate chassis decked out with custom details and performance upgrades, dropping into our Classic Rally class.  


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/2e9216ba6f6e04ec493a5547f69ec19b7372268c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/fc241a295cf79e4344814c21ed6e62d76a962f76.jpg[/img]

Each of the four cars will feature in a new thread of 25 Career events, available in the ‘Uproar’ option in Career. Every event either takes place at night or features dynamically changing weather that includes night racing, creating a fresh test of your nerve, reaction, and skill. The 25 events will take you across the globe in new race scenarios including New York, Nepal, Italy, and South Africa.  

Two sponsors are added into Career mode in the Uproar Content Pack: PUMA and OffRoad Xtreme. Race through Career events when signed to these sponsors to unlock new items, including unique liveries, player profile options and custom livery patterns, to show your style on the track. 

On top of that, we’re adding Achievements/Trophies to all versions of DIRT 5! With Update 4.00 you’ll find Achievements/Trophies connected to playing both the Uproar Career thread, and the recently released Energy Career thread. If you’ve previously played the Energy Career events and meet the requirements for any new Achievement/Trophy, you will automatically unlock them.  

The Uproar Content Pack will be automatically added to DIRT 5 for players who own the Amplified Edition or Year One Upgrade. For all other players, the pack will be available to purchase from Steam for £9.99/€11.49/$12.49.  


[h2]Free DIRT 5 Content for Everyone in Update 4.00 [/h2] 

Free to all players, Update 4.00 includes another huge slate of content across multiple game modes for players to get stuck into.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/92c8e2f549e6ac0a95bc1cb658ec3e36e278af1c.jpg[/img]

Let’s start with Playgrounds, where we’re keeping up the night-time theme with the After Dark Playgrounds Update! Another 20+ items will be added to the custom arena creator mode, all of which come to life at night. Look for bold colour palettes, fireworks, new variants of checkpoints, loops and jumps, and even a multi-coloured disco floor for Gymkhana spin zones! All players will have access to the items via a new tab in Create mode, and all players can take on Playgrounds featuring the new content in Discover mode.  


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/647c1bb7fe9f55bc8930cb9cf2ee96162372a8f7.jpg[/img]

Night-time options for Italy and Arizona will be added, along with the existing night conditions for Cape Town Stadium, to help make the most of the After Dark items. Get creative with these options and design incredible custom arenas that bring the night to life. 

Elsewhere, by popular demand, we’re adding more classic official liveries. In any game mode, iconic liveries are selectable for four off-road legends: the BMW M1 Procar, SUBARU WRX STI RX Supercar, SUBARU Impreza S4 Rally, and MITSUBISHI LANCER EVOLUTION VI. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/736f4267b51d463a21043309bfdec6f3cc2a1da6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/335488bf169cf9b8724000a62fb52d56869e94dc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/59d3da16ca00aa0c3eb2b6d466a0a3df8f75c393.jpg[/img]


[h2]More DIRT 5 Features and Community-Requested Additions [/h2]

We are also thrilled to add several changes and additional features in Update 4.00, all driven by the feedback and suggestions of you, the players.  

Private lobbies will be added to the game’s Online options, allowing players to create a custom race lobby and play with friends via invite. Customise your lobby by selecting the race location, car class, race length, location and weather conditions to create your ideal event, then battle online against the rest of your lobby of up to eight players.  

We’re also adding an area for players to view their game profile statistics, including total miles driven, total races completed and much more. Finally, we’re adding a new feature to Playgrounds mode to help players find the best creations, and to reward the greatest designers: Verified Creators. The DIRT 5 team will be hand-picking the best creators in Playgrounds mode to receive the Verified Creators tag, shown by a ‘tick’ next to their name when their Playgrounds appear in Discover mode – so you know it’s made by one of the best. Keep designing and refining your Playgrounds to see if you get Verified! 

 

Update 4.00 is free for all players and will includes various technical tweaks and fixes to further improve game performance on all platforms. Keep an eye on the DIRT 5 website and our official Discord server for patch notes detailing everything in this update. Below, we have further outlined the upcoming content additions and entitlements: 

  

[b]Amplified Edition/Year One Upgrade content, or purchased separately [/b]

CONTENT AND FEATURES

notes.title: New DIRT 5 content! Cars, events, Playgrounds options, more coming February 22
notes.content:
DIRT 5 continues to offer even more ways to race, create and customise, with a huge slate of new content coming to the game this month!

Tear up the globe in iconic machines, then turn trash into a racing masterpiece, with the arrival on the Energy Content Pack and the FREE Junkyards Playground Update for DIRT 5, launching on February 22!

Four incredible cars from the world’s most famous manufacturers, purpose-built for all-terrain action, come to DIRT 5 alongside brand new content for multiple modes, including our latest drop of themed Playground items to create custom racing arenas with. There’s also more free content for all players, too! Let’s take a closer look... 

[b]ENERGY CONTENT PACK - NEW CARS, NEW CAREER EVENTS, NEW SPONSORS [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/0344b9ac66d03d6c81b2d3a1eaaf06443ae27fa0.png[/img]

Legends of the American and European automotive scenes are represented in the four new cars coming to DIRT 5 via the Energy Content Pack. West of the Atlantic, the Chevrolet Silverado 1500 and GMC Sierra Pre-Runner burst onto the scene – two trucks with immense power, adapted to survive the most extreme conditions. To the east, we find the eye-catching Alpine A110 Sports X – an experimental effort by the iconic French manufacturer, combining sportiness and ruggedness to conquer all routes. The same can be said of the Porsche Taycan Turbo S, a revolutionary electric monster, generating well over 700bhp to mix futuristic power with precision engineering – perfect to let loose around DIRT 5’s varied global routes.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/07266748049d1c44c6e680f5a4d7991179a29486.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/ac7bb7ae330147f47b6dd61be32f0b568623b8ea.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/a202d159ee2aee1eaf3522a2a8287ea3785208ea.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/7b5f84a5644e95da7c89f597a89d85ec83ea7631.jpg[/img]

All four cars are playable in all game modes – including in Career, where we’re adding another 25 bespoke events for you to take on, many of which using classes which feature the four new cars in DIRT 5. Head to Brazil, New York, South Africa, Nepal and more destinations to take part in new scenarios, including dynamic and extreme weather conditions to overcome. Two new exclusive sponsor options will also be available in Career - Xite and MadCroc - and completing the new events when signed to these sponsors will unlock new personalisation items, such as bespoke liveries, stickers, lanyards, and custom livery editor options.   

[b]FREE JUNKYARD PLAYGROUNDS CONTENT [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/fccb537b7cf928c57bbc6f1828dac4e096067f05.jpg[/img]

They say one man’s trash is another man’s treasure, right? It’s time to prove that with DIRT 5’s latest batch of objects to use in Playgrounds – our groundbreaking new mode where players create, share and discover custom racing arenas.  

In this update comes over 20 new items to get creative with – from scrap metal, crushed cars and tyre stacks, to cranes, bulldozers and even our huge scrap-built dinosaur sculpture, we’re bringing you more ways to make your racing arenas unique, challenging and awe-inspiring. Whether you’re smashing into washing machines, spinning around in a shed, or racing toward a finish gate covered in flames, the Junkyard Playgrounds items are yours to use. 

The new Playgrounds items are available to use in Create mode for designing arenas, and any uploaded Playground that features these new items will be available for all players to race on. 

The Junkyard Playgrounds Pack is free for all players and will be automatically added to your game when downloading the new update! The Energy Content Pack is FREE for DIRT 5 Amplified Edition owners, and anyone who owns DIRT 5’s Year One Upgrade. For all other players, the packs can be purchased separately on the Steam store for £9.99/€11.49/$12.49. 

[b]FREE DIRT 5 CONTENT FOR ALL PLAYERS [/b]

On top of all that, we're adding some more free content for you to try out, show off and spark your creativity with Update 3.00. In Playgrounds mode, check out the first new location for your custom racing arenas: Italy! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/8226db9f9b334f335d75f22c05afeda5bf0f178f.jpg[/img]

Joining Arizona and South Africa, and available in clear or snowy conditions, get creative with a blank canvas placed near Italy’s iconic marble mines and bridges, making for the perfect backdrop to your most incredible custom tracks. Italy also offers the first arena to feature two different levels, with a drop in the middle connecting them, offering new possibilities for amazing creations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/b94a4d256b95b214eec0b55882d954403397304d.jpg[/img]

Also, we have more unique livery designs dropping into DIRT 5, for three of our most recognisable off-road machines. Head to the Garage and choose the Ford RS200, Ford Escort RS Cosworth, or the Peugeot 205 T16 Evo 2 to see their new livery options! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/1fc941d661bfcd961bbc84f7a44e92be730dc742.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/825f9416d10e892b0418a60ee0e731d7474d8401.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/a0121ae4b465367a36c837a42e73b28e372f0e62.jpg[/img]

This free-for-everyone content will be added to DIRT 5 in Update 3.00, which will include various technical fixes and optimisations. Further changes and additions, based on community feedback, will also be included, such as an increase to the Level cap. Keep an eye on the DIRT 5 website and our official Discord server for patch notes detailing everything in this update. Below, we have further outlined the upcoming content additions and entitlements:

- Four new cars: Porsche Taycan Turbo S, Alpine A110 Sports X, Chevrolet Silverado 1500, GMC Sierra Pre-Runner

‘Tis the season, right? Celebrate the festive period in style with the FREE Snow Limits content pack for DIRT 5!

[h2][b]Snow Limits - Free Content Pack[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/eae4bb4169908e2a9b1668c6bf25b1959949b415.jpg[/img]

Starting today, we’re decking the halls and filling your stockings with an array of new objects to use in DIRT 5’s Playgrounds mode, where players create, share and discover incredible custom racing arenas. On top of that, the pack includes DIRT’s very own winter wonderland with a brand new race event and some fresh customisation options for your profile and liveries.

[h2][b]New Playgrounds Items and Snow[/b][/h2]

New items will be available for all players to use in each of the three Playgrounds event types. Massive ice loops, checkpoints made from yuletide wreaths and start/finish gates made of gingerbread will guide your way in Gate Crasher. Over in Smash Attack, giant baubles can be placed for cars to destroy. As for Gymkhana events, expect ice rinks for spin zones, Nutcracker figurines to pull donuts around, ice sculptures for drift gates, stacks of presents to obliterate, smashable snowmen and much more.

We’re also adding a new weather condition to set your Playgrounds to: you guessed it, snow! Sprinkle some wintry magic onto your Playgrounds, setting fresh new challenges for other players, creating Christmassy set pieces, or simply draping your arenas with decorations befitting of this most wonderful time of the year. 


[b][h2]New Race Event[/h2][/b]

Also waiting under the tree is a new race to do battle on. Prepare for a fairytale in New York, as we head to Roosevelt Island for a unique Sprint event. Available in Arcade, Time Trial and Online races, the new Sprint event combines ice racing, wintry weather and a host of festive track-side foliage to leave you merrier than old Saint Nick himself.


[b][h2]Customisation Pack[/h2][/b]

Time to freshen up your look and end the year in style, with a host of new customisation items in the Snow Limits pack. For your Profile, find five new lanyards, stickers and card backgrounds to make use of, whilst in the Livery Editor, try out three new fill patterns in your custom designs. Snow Limits continues DIRT 5’s post-launch content plan, including DLC drops throughout 2021 featuring new cars, Career events and much more, with exclusive additions for Amplified Edition and Year One Upgrade players. We'll have more information regarding new content in the new year.



[b][h2]Update 2.00 For DIRT 5 - Rolling Out From Today[/h2][/b]

The Snow Limits pack will be included in Update 2.00 for DIRT 5, which begins to roll out today on PC. This major game update includes the addition of wheel support, as well as some key changes based on community feedback, including handling tweaks for the Sprint car, further visual improvements, and the option to replay episodes of the Career mode podcast. [url=https://bit.ly/2We7C5z]Further details on Update 2.00 can be found here[/url], whilst [url=https://bit.ly/3534rmB]full patch notes are here[/url].

notes.title: DIRT 5 - Further Details on Wheel Support & Next Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Time for more news on DIRT 5's first major update.

Update 2.00 for DIRT 5 is the first post-launch milestone in our commitment to expanding and further improving the game based on feedback from you, the players. Following some patches and further optimisations, 2.00 brings the game’s first significant content addition, with wheel support, as well as more important tweaks that address your requests.

Ahead of Update 2.00’s arrival, we wanted to give a breakdown of what you can expect, as well as lay out the plans going forward for new DIRT 5 content and developments.

[b]Update 2.00 - Wheel Support and Community Requests[/b]

A key topic in the community since DIRT 5’s launch has been the addition of wheel support, and we’re excited to bring you exactly that in Update 2.00. Whilst DIRT 5 is a much more accessible title than other previous Codemasters games, it has been designed to be equally as fun and intuitive on a wheel as it is on a controller. Using data and feedback from previous Codemasters titles, we’ve implemented a wheel support system to work across PC and both generations of consoles, to give you another way to experience each thrilling DIRT 5 event.

In terms of compatible devices, we expect the majority of modern wheel devices, that work across recent Codemasters games and other racing titles, to also be supported in DIRT 5. Much of the compatibility data has been utilised from GRID, meaning if your wheel was fully supported for that game, it’ll be supported by DIRT 5 – as well as other wheels that have released since GRID’s launch.

Modern devices from both Thrustmaster and Logitech are set to be fully supported. As for Fanatec wheels, we expect support for a selection of its wheels, and more to be added as we make further progress over the coming weeks. Peripherals, such as shifters and handbrakes, will also work if they are connected to the wheel itself. In-game, you'll have menus and detailed options to adjust input bindings, vibration, feedback, sensitivity and much more. 

We’ll be closely monitoring all feedback regarding wheel and peripheral support as the update rolls out, and are committed to making further tweaks, if required, based on your reports and suggestions. Whilst this info should have you covered, we're working on a full wheel list to publish soon, too.

[b]More Changes in DIRT 5 Update 2.00[/b]

Every day since DIRT 5’s launch, we’ve been listening to your feedback, collating reports and mapping out in-game tweaks to further improve your experience – and that continues in Update 2.00.

More changes will come to Online multiplayer, specifically looking to make it easier for players to find lobbies and events more consistently. We’ll be adding more Online race events, too, including some multi-class races. The issues some players have with using Amplified Edition sponsors in Career will also be resolved in 2.00.

Following community feedback, we’ve also made adjustments to the handling of the Sprint car, making it a little easier to get to grips with. Over in Career, you’ll find a new option to select and replay any episode of the DIRT Podcast by Donut Media, with James Pumphrey and Nolan Sykes walking through the latest story developments, featuring Alex ‘AJ’ Janicek (Troy Baker) and Bruno Durand (Nolan North).

In Playgrounds, we’re continuing to offer you multiple ways to discover and race on incredible user-created arenas. Every week, you can find a refreshed list of Featured Playgrounds, hand-picked by the DIRT 5 team as the most creative and exciting to take on. Use other sections in Discover to find specific creations, or if you’ve seen a Playground shared online that you need to try out, use the Search tab to type in its name.

Along with the above, Update 2.00 will bring a host of bug fixes, optimisations, and general quality of life improvements, along with further visual improvements. Full patch notes for this update will be published before it goes live, and we'll keep you posted as we prepare to roll this out in the coming days.

Got something you want to report or tell us about? Use our [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd-YqrLl5GxlUZU3evPi5sK18cA80Awp9Hhc4vwTDOHit-9fg/viewform]dedicated feedback form[/url] to give us the info needed to investigate, and head to the [url=https://discord.com/invite/BYGnqQB]official DIRT 5 Discord[/url] to chat with the team.

notes.title: DIRT 5 - Latest News on Next Update, Wheel Support and More
notes.content:
Hey everyone – as we near the end of November I wanted to check in with news on how things are going with DIRT 5’s next update. Currently, we are looking to finalise this latest update over the next few days, then roll out across all platforms following submissions.   

We’re pleased to able to bring wheel support into DIRT 5 with the next update, with the majority of modern and popular devices set to be supported by the game. We're working on getting this feature absolutely right before pushing it live. Before the update rolls out we will bring you more details on the wheel support feature, which will be even further developed in future updates, too.   

That’s just the start of the changes coming to DIRT 5 in this latest update, that are driven by your feedback. You can expect changes to the handling of Sprint cars, technical tweaks to Online play to encourage more matchmaking, further visual improvements, and much more. Full patch notes will be shared prior to Update 2.00’s release. Please check you have updated drivers and are on the latest version of Windows. The majority of crash reports we receive on PC continue to be caused by this – but for the other reports, we’re squashing some bugs and optimising further. 

Along with these additions and changes, all players can expect a special surprise with this latest update! It’s the beginning of our commitment to regular content updates to your DIRT 5 experience fresh, and a way of thanking our community for your support so far.  

As always, if you have anything you want to tell us about your DIRT 5 experience, [url=https://discord.gg/BYGnqQB]talk with us on Discord[/url], and/or use our [url=https://forms.gle/ZraHaTN4ENtpksYN7 ]feedback form[/url].

Thank you for your support – we’ll have full news on all the above very soon.

Hey all,

The latest patch for PC is rolling out now for players on Steam. Key changes in this update include:

- Multiple general performance improvements across the board, reducing instances of crashes, gameplay stuttering and FPS drops, further optimising general gameplay
- Fix for crash caused by signing out during a Gymkhana event
- Visual improvements to rain effects on windshield when using interior camera views
- Display fix for rewards screen in post-race menu
- Photo mode: minor fixes and optimisations
- Multiplayer: improvements in kicking players in lobby who do not ready up for an event
- V-Sync added
- Added option to disable dynamic resolution

We’re using a feedback report system to gather this feedback and help us investigate issues, so please feel free to send a report here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd-YqrLl5GxlUZU3evPi5sK18cA80Awp9Hhc4vwTDOHit-9fg/viewform

Whilst we make further improvements, please ensure you have updated your drivers, have updated Windows to at least version 1903, and have adjusted the in-game Video Options to work best for your specs/setup. Thank you!

notes.title: DIRT 5 - Official Launch Trailer and Soundtrack Album Revealed
notes.content:
Conquer stunning global locations. Rise to glory in a star-studded story. Tame seven decades of off-road cars. Get creative with photo mode and a livery editor. Share the fun with split-screen and party modes. Design the racing arena of your dreams.

This is DIRT 5. Time to LET LOOSE.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/61b556a7666ba5b1c714bdf260d77d953c64ca28.jpg[/img]

Check out the official launch trailer for DIRT 5, giving you a taste of the amplified racing action on offer in the biggest, boldest DIRT game ever made – from truck racing through Italian marble mines, to ice racing on New York’s East River, to the returning Gymkhana events, and so much more.

The trailer also features the voice of Troy Baker, who features in DIRT 5’s Career mode as Alex ‘AJ’ Janicek.

[previewyoutube=K96Pe0jvpfk;full][/previewyoutube]

Alongside the launch trailer, we are also excited to unveil the official DIRT 5 Soundtrack album, available to stream and download across major digital music platforms including Apple Music!

Music is a massive part of the vibe and style and DIRT 5, and we’ve already confirmed an incredible line-up artists for the in-game soundtrack, including Stormzy, Pearl Jam, The Prodigy and Barns Courtney. Today, we reveal an 18-track album for public release, featuring more huge names like The Killers and The Chemical Brothers, along with brand new exclusive tracks from the likes High Contrast, Sea Girls and Broken Witt Rebels. The latter’s new single, ‘Take It’, features DIRT 5 in the cover art and music video!

1. High Contrast – Griffin (exclusive)
2. Noisy – Tourist (exclusive)
3. Prospa – Feel It 92 (exclusive)
4. Koko – Silly With It (exclusive)
5. Broken Witt Rebels – Take It (exclusive)
6. Sea Girls – Accident Waiting To Happen (exclusive)
7. Saronde – Veru (exclusive)
8. The Chemical Brothers – Bango
9. EOB – Shangri-La – Spike Stent Edit
10. The Killers – Caution
11. Hero The Band – Shout
12. THE HARA – Friends
13. Tyler Bryant & The Shakedown – Drive Me Mad
14. Inhaler – We Have To Move On
15. The Academic – SUPERLIKE
16. Twin Atlantic – Volcano
17. Tesla – Tied To The Tracks
18. Arkells – Years In The Making

More information on the Official Soundtrack album can be found here – https://globe.lnk.to/Dirt5US

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37715099/97a7fe63eb772809eb6bd2b15c3b4851f7713dde.jpg[/img]

“DIRT 5 is a celebration of speed, set on some of the toughest terrains in the most stunning global locations,” said Robert Karp, DIRT 5 Development Director at Codemasters. “From bustling cities to sprawling off-road destinations, it’s time to let loose and put your foot to the floor. 

"Whether battling through Career, voiced by Troy Baker and Nolan North, competing with friends on the couch or creating the ultimate Playground, there is something for all race fans to enjoy.”

DIRT 5 is coming to PC on November 6. Players who purchase DIRT 5 Amplified Edition will receive exclusive content and three days early access - more details on the DIRT 5 store page!

notes.title: DIRT 5 - The Car List
notes.content:
Travelling the globe to race in iconic destinations and stunning routes is one thing. Being behind the wheel of the most incredible off-road machines whilst doing all of that? Now THAT’S what DIRT 5 is all about.


The full car list for DIRT 5’s launch from November 6 is now confirmed, with a roster of rides spanning 13 classes and seven different decades of automotive history. From ultra-light speed machines to desert-conquering trucks, 60’s racing heroes to 2020 models, variety runs deep in our line-up of cars.


A host of cars never seen before in the DIRT franchise feature, including the Audi TT Safari and Ariel Nomad Tactical, and brand new cars like the Aston Martin DBX and MITSUBISHI e-EVOLUTION. They’re joined by iconic off-roaders that no DIRT game would be complete without, such as the SUBARU Impreza S4 Rally and Ford RS200. Trucks and buggies from specialist manufacturers Brenthel, Jimco and Armada feature, alongside American icons from Chevrolet and Cadillac.


Each car will be visually customisable through DIRT 5’s livery editor, and also feature liveries which are unlocked as you progress through the game, including designs by artists Sean Bull Design and Death Spray Custom.

notes.title: DIRT 5 - Three Latest Gameplay Videos - New Cars, Locations, Events
notes.content:
With DIRT 5's November 6 launch on Steam racing into view, we've been busy revealing more work-in-progress gameplay of the amplified off-road racer. Check out our three latest three videos below for almost 10 minutes of racing action in DIRT 5!
 


[h2]CAPE TOWN STADIUM RACING [/h2]

Taking inspiration from arena-based action in previous DIRT games, South Africa's Cape Town Stadium is the perfect setting for some close-quarters racing with jumps, crossover and a roaring crowd. Take the action through the stadium, the parking lot, and the outer area for a thrilling route, available in Career, Arcade and online play

[previewyoutube=9O-lKb8rJdg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]MOROCCO SANDSTORM[/h2]

Get a look at how DIRT 5’s extreme dynamic weather can transform a race in this gameplay video, with super-light machines racing in Morocco and battling through an ever-approaching sandstorm, which engulfs the circuit mid-race.

Land Rush events like these in DIRT 5 bring off-road terrain and extreme routes for rough-and-ready cars, available across multiple locations in the game. 


[previewyoutube=eB1fgwWzuPU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]FROZEN EAST RIVER RACING [/h2]

Our latest DIRT 5 early gameplay takes you to New York, with classic Ford and Peugeot rally cars battling on the frozen East River! 

This Ice Breaker event by Roosevelt Island is at the dead of night, with incredible lighting, atmosphere and fireworks making for a unique racing experience. Up to 12 cars can do battle in Ice Breaker events, with multiple layouts and locations available.

[previewyoutube=MF71f0Z-m4U;full][/previewyoutube]


Pre-orders are available now for DIRT 5, including a 10% discount on the Amplified Edition for players of any previous DIRT title on Steam!
